bienvenida.intro: Authorise HT Lens through Hattrick's official connection. Then you can sync your squad, training, finances and matches whenever you choose.
bienvenida.sesionVencida: Your session has expired. Reconnect with Hattrick to continue; your saved data won't be lost.

bienvenida.paso3: HT Lens doesn't run a full sync until you ask for it.
bienvenida.legal: HT Lens uses information from Hattrick.org with the permission of its owners. Your Hattrick credentials never pass through this application.
bienvenida.gratis: HT Lens is free. I pay for the server myself, US$7 a month.

juveniles.intro: Who deserves a place, who you'll lose soon and whether the academy pays off
juveniles.equilibrar: {{n}} more sale(s) at the average price would be needed to break even.
juveniles.explicaTrain: scores each skill by what your academy can gain in it, and the recommended pair comes from that. The controls below are yours: move the deadline cut-off or the gap between rungs and the ranking is recalculated. The split adopts the recommendation on its own until you choose something else manually in the next tab.
juveniles.explicaWho: distributes the two chosen trainings among the eleven and the bench. Each training reaches some positions and not others: whoever lands where the two overlap gets both. Within each group the best in the queue go first (rung, ceiling and age), so changing the secondary changes who plays where. The “Can reach” bar is their HTMS28: the filled part is what they already have, and how far the bar goes is the most they could reach.
